details: Bitcoin rose above the $65,000 level on Monday morning (July 27) as an easing of tensions in the Middle East over the weekend reportedly boosted risk appetite in the broader financial markets.
title: Bitcoin Climbs Above $65K as Middle East Tensions Ease

details: While Bitcoin and Ethereum saw modest gains, high-beta altcoins, particularly meme coins like SHIB (+36.93%), PEPE (+10.19%), and DOGE (+5.82%), experienced significant surges in the last 24 hours. This retail-driven rally contrasts with Bitcoin spot ETFs recording -$240.1M in net outflows, signaling a fragmented market between retail risk-on and institutional caution.
title: Speculative Altcoins & Meme Coins See Major Gains; Institutional Outflows Continue

details: Cryptocurrency exchange BitMart has initiated a phased shutdown, halting deposits and new orders. All trading activities are scheduled to cease on August 26. Following this announcement, its native token, BMX, plummeted approximately 63% in 24 hours.
title: BitMart Exchange Announces Phased Shutdown, BMX Token Plummets 63%

details: Bitcoin's daily correlation with the S&P 500 fell to 0.12 in the second quarter, while its link to gold rose to 0.57. This suggests investors are increasingly treating digital assets as scarce stores of value rather than high-beta tech plays. However, this decoupling could remain fragile if rising Brent crude prices reignite inflation concerns, potentially driving Treasury yields higher.
title: Bitcoin Decouples from Tech Stocks, Shifts Towards Gold Correlation

details: Sberbank, Russia's largest bank, is planning to launch a crypto trading platform and a digital custody system by December 2026. This move comes ahead of new Russian crypto regulations set to take effect on September 1.
title: Russia's Sberbank to Launch Crypto Trading Platform by December 2026

details: The CLARITY Act remains a key legislative event in the crypto market, with brokerage giant Charles Schwab urging the US Senate to pass the bill. However, the odds of the bill passing in 2026 have dropped to 34% on Polymarket, as Senate Democrats demand stricter ethics rules regarding presidential crypto ventures.
title: CLARITY Act's Passage Odds Drop Amid Senate Demands

details: Two Ethereum bridges, AFX and Verus-Ethereum, collectively lost $31.7 million due to infrastructure compromises within hours. This incident underscores persistent security vulnerabilities within the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem.
title: Ethereum Bridges Suffer $31.7 Million in Exploits
